# Rule hypothesis: split by full separator lines (rows/cols of a single color) into blocks;
# count marker-color cells per block; output grid (blocks x blocks) with 1 where count==2, else background.
demo_in=[[5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,4,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,7,4,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[4,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,4,5,5,5],[7]*19,[5,5,5,5,7,5,4,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,4,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,4,4,7,4,5,5,5]]
demo_out=[[5,5,5,5],[5,5,1,5]]
def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sep_rows=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1]
    sep_cols=[c for c in range(W) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in range(H) for c,x in enumerate(g[r]) if c not in sep_cols and r not in sep_rows).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=Counter(x for r in range(H) for c,x in enumerate(g[r]) if c not in sep_cols and r not in sep_rows and x!=bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # block row ranges
    rr=[];prev=0
    for r in sep_rows+[H]:
        if r>prev: rr.append((prev,r)); prev=r+1
    cc=[];prev=0
    for c in sep_cols+[W]:
        if c>prev: cc.append((prev,c)); prev=c+1
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in rr:
        row=[]
        for c0,c1 in cc:
            n=sum(1 for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if g[r][c]==marker)
            row.append(1 if n==2 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
print(transform(demo_in)==demo_out)
